name: Spanish
notes: Eleven courses: two foundation, three core, six electives.
SPAN 205 or 206 are highly recommended. AP credit may cover SPAN 151/152 depending on score and placement.
SPAN 203 may be replaced by an approved alternative. Study in a Spanish-speaking country is strongly recommended.

requirementGroups.label: Foundation courses (fulfil upper-level writing)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: FOUNDATION COURSES (fulfills upper level writing): CLTR 200: Topics in Critical Thinking; CLTR 389: MLC Research Seminar

requirementGroups.label: Advanced Spanish Composition
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: CORE COURSES: SPAN 200: Advanced Spanish Composition

requirementGroups.label: Literature survey
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: SPAN 202: The Forging of a Nation or SPAN 204: Coming to Terms: Spanish American Literature

requirementGroups.label: Representing Identities in the Early Hispanic World
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: SPAN 203: Representing Identities in the Early Hispanic World (or an approved alternative)

requirementGroups.label: Spanish electives (6)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: ELECTIVE COURSES: Six additional courses which could include SPAN 151 and 152 and 200-level electives in Spanish. SPAN 205 or 206 are highly recommended.
